summary: Backend API+WS regression tests passed on public endpoint; frontend lobby/start flows pass, but core in-game interaction validations are blocked/failing in UI runs.

ui_bugs.issue: Death overlay frequently appears during/soon after join in headless runs and intercepts pointer actions, preventing stable gameplay interactions test execution.
Mouse wheel zoom did not change data-camera-zoom (remained 24) across repeated wheel actions during UI tests.

integration_issues.issue: Observed no authoritative UI change for movement coordinates and ammo in repeated desktop runs (coords and ammo unchanged).
Settings/leaderboard modal open checks from gameplay were not reliably reachable in automated runs due gameplay state interruption/death overlay.

action_items: Investigate why gameplay sessions in UI runs quickly reach death/interruption and block deterministic interaction testing.
Verify wheel zoom event path on game canvas in real browser interaction; confirm data-camera-zoom updates from default 24.
Verify in-game input handling (WASD/fire/reload) from frontend to websocket when HUD is active and player alive.
Re-run full frontend e2e after stabilizing gameplay entry state.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend tests were initially failing because REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL was read only from process env; test now loads frontend/.env fallback for stable public-endpoint execution.
Root->Loadout contract is correctly testable via data-testid coverage; gameplay testability degrades when death overlay interrupts interaction timing.
test_credentials: File exists but contains no credentials; auth flows were not in this scope.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Start screen and loadout requirements passed: single START GAME, dynamic background canvas, 4 weapon cards, ARIA selection, showcase updates, weapon preview naturalWidth=1440, mobile root/loadout no overflow and controls visible. Backend REST+WS contract test passed (2/2). Remaining risk is deterministic in-game interaction validation (movement/fire/reload/zoom/modal) under fast death/interruption in headless runs.
rca of the issue: Observed repeated gameplay interruption by death overlay during UI automation. Repro: join from /loadout, enter /play, within test window interactions frequently become non-actionable and overlay intercepts pointer; consequently wheel zoom and control assertions remain unchanged. Suggested mitigation for testing: temporarily ensure alive window before interaction checks (e.g., immediate respawn handling and timed assertions right after state reception) and manually validate zoom/input on non-headless browser once.
